document.abstract: Since the image upon the screen of the theater represents and is the finished product of the motion picture industry displayed for purchase by the amusement buying public, and since this is the only goods of any sort which the industry has for sale, it seems eminently fitting and proper that we spend a few moments in consideration of the faults most commonly found therein, and in examining into the possibilities for at least their partial correction, if their complete elimination is deemed not practicable.
